purpose: Record current primary ownership, dependencies, and prohibited authority couplings without becoming runtime authority or removing any route or capability.

authoritativeSources.cloudflare: versioned Worker and Pages configuration plus verified provider state
authoritativeSources.authorization: server-side Workers, RPCs, RLS policies, storage policies, and sandbox access validation

invariants: This manifest is documentation and test input only and must never be imported by runtime application code.
Every registered destination route has exactly one primary presentation owner even when it consumes shared services.
Frontend visibility and route guards are user-experience controls, never authorization.
Public Commons Profile remains canonical public profile authority; Artisan is a consumer and must not create a second identity authority.
Badge recognition is not a role, permission, moderation power, governance authority, trust score, payment status, or social rank.
Payment, voluntary support, hosted-execution allowance, and community participation remain separate concepts.
Stripe is a provider behind the economic boundary and is never called directly by a sandbox runner or browser as authority.
Hosted-execution credits are non-transferable service-use units with no cash value and never weaken sandbox security.
Local Elysia, local computation, and community participation are not metered by EcoSyneva.
Shared infrastructure may be reused, but source-domain state and mutation authority remain with the named owner.
No route, deep link, domain world, workflow, or authority is removed by this manifest.

routeSelectionSemantics.exact: Matches the complete resolved route pattern.
routeSelectionSemantics.prefix: Matches the prefix itself or a slash-delimited descendant.
routeSelectionSemantics.prefixLiteral: Matches any route pattern beginning with the literal value.
routeSelectionSemantics.excludeExact: Removes an exact route from a broader selector because another bounded domain owns it.
routeSelectionSemantics.wildcard: Matches only the registered wildcard pattern.

sharedServices.rule: Group discovery without deleting, redirecting, or hiding established destinations.
Notifications project authoritative source events and never grant source-domain authority.
Awards require server-side source evidence, idempotency, durable history, revocation semantics, and separation from all authority and payment.
Identity, access, reservation, execution isolation, measurement, settlement/release, cancellation, receipts, and cleanup each remain independently enforced.
Every upload is owner-scoped, size/type bounded, quarantine-aware where applicable, and cleaned through the source lifecycle.
Record outcomes and correlation identifiers without secrets, credentials, message bodies, private profile data, or provider payloads.

forbiddenCouplings.prohibition: No purchase, support, allowance, or payment state grants or improves a badge.
No payment state grants a role, moderation power, governance authority, or trust.
Hosted-execution allowances are not a wallet, transferable value, seller payment, commission balance, or Marketplace currency.
The runner cannot call Stripe or decide price, grant type, entitlement, or economic policy.
Artisan cannot create another account, profile authority, user directory, or cross-origin session bridge.
Navigation state, hidden controls, route guards, copy, and badges never substitute for server authorization.
Local Elysia and local computation are not metered by EcoSyneva.
